confirmed_mechanics: Both paid source observers and the shared identity witness admit at most two receipts for the exact original source/reader/effective deadline/admission.
First successful proveClosed consumes one receipt but leaves the second registered and the original observer installed.
Second successful proveClosed settles both; a refusal invalidates the original observations and conditionally restores or retains the observer under the existing frozen API.
Positive original framework commit, depth0 and historical frozen row/identity comparisons are required; idle PDO alone supplies no commit proof.
Existing gateway financialState performs the six bounded GETs through pinned SDK and strips payment client_secret; source exports no original Charge ID.
Candidate remains unattested input consistency with providerAuthenticated=false; no new source, commit, provider, grant/refund/access/rights/inventory authority.

required_design_changes.finding: Caller originalDeadlineNs can exceed the privately clamped source lifetime. A guard using only that caller value or a fresh plan-start budget can permit a GET after the original source cap, then refuse only at terminal proof.
required_design_changes.required: Specify an internal exact typed capture of the already-established effective observer/context deadline while held, and retain it unchanged for every request pre/post and publication check. No source recapture, caller-created budget authority or frozen source edit. If no admissible path is chosen, narrow the claimed timing guarantee before implementation.
required_design_changes.tests: Almost-expired original source, deliberately later caller deadline, callback delaying past effective cap: no subsequent GET and terminal refusal without renewal.

required_design_changes.finding: The current always-consume clause addresses terminal SDK paths but does not explicitly cover first proof, policy/setup failure or an unused plan left after original commit.
required_design_changes.required: Claim once before callback-capable work; try/finally must attempt every remaining owned receipt at most once on early refusal as well as SDK success/failure. Specify idempotent abandonment/close for unused observations and best-effort cleanup that preserves the initiating redacted error. It must not commit/rollback/abort/retry a caller or reopened frame. Held and failed-factory physical cleanup remains with the caller retaining original source/frame handles; clarify source-kind-specific poisoned-observer behavior.
required_design_changes.tests: First-proof failure, disabled policy before SDK, SDK throw, abandoned committed plan, failed second mint and reopened/peer frame preservation; fresh authorized source retry after proper original-owner cleanup.

required_design_changes.finding: ApiRequestor calls _maybeEmitStripeNotice after guarded request() returns; Stripe-Notice can trigger an error handler that replaces the global transport slot. The next _requestRaw retrieves that slot again and could bypass the guard.
required_design_changes.required: Reject or suppress callback-producing response notice headers before returning to SDK; admit exact raw slot identity at guard entry/exit and explicitly bound the SDK post-guard callback surface. Keep exact sequence/response/body limits. Existing gateway finally unconditionally restores its saved transport slot, so do not claim preservation of a callback-owned replacement of that slot; TLS/config/connection mutations remain unmodified and must cause refusal.
required_design_changes.tests: Real error-handler sentinel plus attempted transport-slot displacement, no seventh/unguarded request, terminal receipt settlement and exact existing saved-slot restoration.

remaining_implementation_conditions: Raw Container/Facade/Repository/DB maps and exact native connection/statement metadata must be admitted by the new wrapper before frozen entries and before zero-transaction checks; no invocation of resolver/ArrayAccess/subclass hooks.
Per-request guards include every admitted current application connection, both Laravel depth and native PDO transaction state; reject unsupported/lazy peer shapes rather than resolving them.
Synthetic transport provenance remains explicitly testing/local as designed; default false/nonboolean/staging/production/unbound paths dispatch nothing.

Request authorization includes exact GET order/path/params/headers/version, own account/no context, retry0/filefalse, PI-returned bounded charge locator, cumulative raw response budget and primitive shape refusal before SDK decoding.
Only captured pure comparisons remain after terminal source proof and before candidate return; no newly resolved source or authority.
SDK/global/transport restoration and late failure do not imply transaction cleanup ownership or positive financial state.
approval_limits: Planning REVISE only. No source/test/native/provider/host/full acceptance approval. Actual implementation, focused SQLite/native evidence, sealed exact-head independent decision and cheap preflight/inventory/expected-SHA merge remain required.
adjacent_deferred: Frozen V1/Identity metadata and ordinary membership afterCommit P2s stay outside this batch; new composition must guard its own reached surfaces without claiming those helpers repaired.
